summary: LSCEO Grant submission integration switched from Apps Script Web App to direct Google Sheets API via service account. Verified end-to-end: (1) POST /api/lsceo-grant/submit returns 200 {ok:true, row_id:'sheet-row-N'} and appends a correctly-mapped row to sheet 1Ah_lT77AbuLxAorAUf4-AGMUXncK9OgXLDe_X4OI54Y tab '2026'; (2) Frontend flow from /life-sciences-ceo/grant?apply=1 with all four Yes answers -> Section 2 -> Submit shows [data-testid='grant-form-success'] and lands a row (row 19) in the sheet with phone '+16175557788' preserved; (3) Ineligible branch (any Section 1 'No') routes to [data-testid='grant-form-ineligible'] and issues 0 backend POSTs. Read-back via service account confirmed every field maps to the correct column, Timestamp auto-fills, and the 'Softr Record ID' column stays blank.
action_items: Optional: clean up TEST_ rows (17, 18, 19) from the '2026' tab after review. Row 19 is the frontend E2E row (email test-fe-1787031422@example.com); rows 17-18 are backend pytest rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _write_signup_to_google_sheet: good separation of concerns; Timestamp auto-fill by header name is robust.
Phone-number apostrophe prefix ('+16175557788') is correctly stripped by Sheets for display while preserving the + as text — verified via gspread read-back.
Endpoint intentionally returns HTTP 200 even on failure (with ok:false) for Cloudflare compatibility — well-documented in the docstring.
Consider adding server-side payload validation with a Pydantic model (currently accepts raw dict). Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Two backend test rows (17,18) + one frontend E2E test row (19) appended to '2026' tab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Integration now uses direct Sheets API via GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_B64 + LSCEO_GRANT_SHEET_ID. The Apps Script URL is gone. Regression test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_lsceo_grant.py and can be re-run any time; it locates its inserted row by unique TEST_<ts> email so it is self-contained. Ineligible branch does not hit the backend, so no cleanup on that path.
rca of the issue: Prior submission failures were caused by the Google Apps Script Web App URL returning HTTP 403 'Access Denied' (Workspace-level policy silently overrode the 'Anyone' access setting on the deployment). Fix bypassed Apps Script entirely and writes directly to the Google Sheet via the pre-existing service account writer (vanguard-forms-writer@vanguard-forms-for-emergent.iam.gserviceaccount.com), which the sheet owner explicitly shared as Editor. Verified in prod preview: backend POST -> row appended -> read-back matches payload exactly.
